EmailTemplate.description: General Case Management Template for Sun Devil Card Services
EmailTemplate.name: Case Mgmt | Sun Devil Card Services Ineligible for Mailing - Freshman
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Unfortunately, ASU does not mail ID cards to First-Time Freshman. Your ASU ID will be available for pick up at your scheduled New Student Orientation, which is on DATE.
If you are unable to attend your New Student Orientation, visit a Sun Devil Card Services location to receive your card. Hours and locations https://cfo.asu.edu/cardservices#fees-and-location
Regards, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Sun Devil Card Services Arizona State University Phone: 480-965-2273 cardservices.asu.edu
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
